mapper.select: SELECT task.* FROM agent_worker_task task WHERE task.status = 'QUEUED' AND task.updated_at < #{olderThan} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_worker_task_outbox_event event WHERE event.task_id = task.task_id AND event.dispatch_version = task.dispatch_version ) ORDER BY task.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
